description: This file provides Windows compatibility functions and macros for the Git project, including path validation, UTF-8/UTF-16 conversions, SSL support wrappers, and platform-specific utilities. It is intended to facilitate cross-platform operation by abstracting Windows-specific implementations.

methods.name: mingw_core_config
methods.description: Configures platform-specific settings based on input variables.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_fd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Wrapper around SSL_set_fd to handle Windows file descriptors.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_rfd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Wrapper around SSL_set_rfd for Windows file descriptors.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_wfd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Wrapper around SSL_set_wfd for Windows file descriptors.

methods.name: mingw_query_user_email
methods.description: Function to query the user's email (implementation not shown).

methods.name: is_path_owned_by_current_sid
methods.description: Verifies if a path is owned by the current user security identifier.

methods.name: is_valid_win32_path
methods.description: Checks if a Windows path is valid according to specific rules.

methods.name: xutftowcsn
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to UTF-16LE wide character string with buffer size limit.

methods.name: int xutftowcs(wchar_t * wcs,const char * utf,size_t wcslen)
methods.description: Simplified version of xutftowcsn assuming null-terminated string.

methods.name: int xutftowcs_path(wchar_t * wcs,const char * utf)
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16LE for file path, with buffer size check.

methods.name: xwcstoutf
methods.description: Converts UTF-16LE wide string to UTF-8.

methods.name: wmain
methods.description: Main entry point for wide-character arguments on Windows.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Standard C main function, possibly called after UTF-16 to UTF-8 conversion.

methods.name: open_in_gdb
methods.description: Opens a GDB debugging session attached to the current process.

methods.name: err_win_to_posix
methods.description: Converts Windows error code to POSIX error code.

ctags.name: xutftowcs
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int xutftowcs(wchar_t *wcs, const char *utf, size_t wcslen)$/
